name: Term Finance tETH price-feed decimals mismatch
summary: Term Finance's TermPriceConsumerV3 scales each feed answer by the feed's own decimals(). During a feed migration Term pointed the tETH primary feed at a new TermTEthPriceFeed whose decimals() is hard-coded to 18 while its answer, tETH.convertToAssets(1e18) times the 8-decimal TermWstEthPriceFeed answer divided by 1e18, has 8 decimals. usdValueOfTokens(tETH, 1e18) fell from $2,147.85 to $0.000000215, putting a healthy tETH-collateralised borrower into shortfall; two public liquidators seized 763.245 tETH in the next two blocks against about 8.5e-8 WETH of repayment.
notes: Term's DEVOPS Safe (via module 0x0c19d8a404079d71e5ca3e32fe3f758ab543acdf) called addNewTokenPriceFeed(tETH, 0xcc670a67566cd86e68b4c08e3692e1c35afa3c1f, 86400), replacing primary feed 0x4b24cce36bce862b16db35d4ade14ca7c200121d (decimals 8) with TermTEthPriceFeed (declares 18, answers in 8). usdValueOfTokens(tETH, 1e18) changed from 2,147.85133084e18 at block 22353824 to 2.15424411105e-7 e18 at block 22353825.
TermTEthPriceFeed with decimals() hard-coded to 18 over an 8-decimal answer; deployed about 34 hours before the consumer was pointed at it.

Exact tETH moved from Term repo lockers to third-party liquidators in the only two liquidations executed while the bad feed was live: 173.087913214804282846 tETH from locker 0x5a665719a1bd1988ff906494777355d2a1080e87 to 0xfb9ae69c81610616bb7d3e8772b5933c7a16d75d (anchor, log 455) and 576.023352242445300288 tETH from locker 0xeac81e82ff8302a66a53779aa29412b88b95372a to 0x00000f91109c4d0007e90000d9facad5298a0cac (0xaa10cc07..., block 22353827, log 24). The borrower 0xe0478344ed218fe29f018caa9da1378c12fef331 lost 763.245440277197688475 tETH in total; the 14.134174819948105341 tETH protocol seizure share went to Term's protocol-reserve Safe 0xad30d904de4302ea13ef09242b49fcbf3822cb88 and is not counted as stolen. Liquidator repayments of 8.4927612073e-8 WETH are attacker-supplied and negligible and are not netted. Valued at DefiLlama's tETH quote $2,140.66 (timestamp 1745677615); cross-checks: the pre-change Term oracle valued tETH at $2,147.8513 and the liquidators sold 745.37 tETH for 877.05 WETH in the same transactions. Term's reported recoveries (about 556 ETH, 362 ETH / ~$650k net protocol loss) do not reduce gross loss. Two later dust liquidations of the same borrower at block 22362660 (4.3e-9 and 6.7e-10 tETH, after the feed was replaced at block 22362657) are immaterial and excluded.
Not the knot: the defective feed was inert until the later configuration change in target-1 selected it as the tETH primary feed, which is the latest age reset of the exploited combination.
